title: Treaty of Trianon
summary: Signed on 4 June 1920, Trianon fixed the frontiers of Hungary after the break-up of Austria-Hungary and left it with under a third of the kingdom's former territory and some three million Hungarian speakers outside its borders, in Romania, Czechoslovakia and Yugoslavia. Hungary called it a dictate and campaigned against it for twenty years; every Hungarian government of the interwar period was a revisionist government, and the alignment with Germany that followed was bought with the return of some of the lost districts. It is in the atlas as the clearest case of the Paris settlement creating the grievance that undid it.
